title: How Ray Tracing Skips Millions of Triangles
description:
One ray could face millions of triangles, but a real-time renderer does not test them all. This short animation explains bounding volume hierarchies, branch rejection and how nested boxes make empty space cheap to search.

Sources:
https://microsoft.github.io/DirectX-Specs/d3d/Raytracing.html
https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/thinking-parallel-part-ii-tree-traversal-gpu/

Visuals: original Pulse Gaming diagrams.
Narration: generated locally with Kokoro TTS.
Music: an original ElevenLabs sound-effects bed licensed for finished editorial video.
Synthetic media disclosure: Yes.
